name: Kálócfa (Hungary)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of blue, yellow and green, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kálócfa (a green and blue shield with a figure, a griffin and a wavy stripe) below the name KÁLÓCFA in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
